abstract: Pre-trained language models (PLMs) are fundamental for natural language processing applications. Most existing PLMs are not tailored to the noisy user-generated text on social media, and the pre-training does not factor in the valuable social engagement logs available in a social network. We present TwHIN-BERT, a multilingual language model productionized at Twitter, trained on in-domain data from the popular social network. TwHIN-BERT differs from prior pre-trained language models as it is trained with not only text-based self-supervision but also with a social objective based on the rich social engagements within a Twitter heterogeneous information network (TwHIN). Our model is trained on 77 billion tweets covering over 100100 distinct languages, providing a valuable representation to model short, noisy, user-generated text. We evaluate our model on various multilingual social recommendation and semantic understanding tasks and demonstrate significant metric improvement over established pre-trained language models. We open-source TwHIN-BERT and our curated hashtag prediction and social engagement benchmark datasets to the research community1.

bibliographic.title: TwHIN-BERT: A Socially-Enriched Pre-trained Language Model for Multilingual Tweet Representations at Twitter
bibliographic.venue: Proceedings of the 29th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining

content.problem: Most pre-trained language models target general text corpora, so they handle short, noisy user-generated text on social media poorly and ignore the social engagement signals inside social networks.
content.proposed_solution: TwHIN-BERT is a multilingual Twitter language model pre-trained with masked language modeling plus a contrastive social objective built from socially similar Tweet pairs mined through network embedding.
dataset_testbed: 7 billion Tweets in 100 languages collected from Jan. 2020 to Jun. 2022 for pre-training, with 100 billion user-Tweet engagement records covering 1 billion Tweets
Twitter Heterogeneous Information Network (TwHIN) with about 200 million users, 1 billion Tweets, and over 100 billion engagement edges
Curated Tweet engagement prediction dataset sampled from the 50 most popular languages on Twitter
Curated multilingual Tweet hashtag prediction dataset covering 50 popular languages
SemEval2018 Task 2 emoji prediction datasets in English and Spanish
SemEval2020 Task 9 code-mixed sentiment datasets in Hindi+English and Spanish+English
COVID-JA Japanese Tweet topic classification dataset
16 Nvidia A100 GPUs (a2-megagpu-16g) and a FAISS index on a 16 A100 GPU node for training and pair mining

content.claim: TwHIN-BERT outperforms established multilingual and Twitter-specific language models on both social engagement prediction and semantic classification tasks, and the social objective produces the largest gains on social tasks.

evidence.problem_quote: Despite the success of PLMs in general-domain NLP, fewer attempts have been made in language model pre-training for user-generated text on social media. In this work, we pre-train a language model for Twitter – a prominent social media platform where users post short messages called Tweets.
evidence.proposed_solution_quote: We introduce TwHIN-BERT– a multilingual language model for Twitter pre-trained with social engagements. The key idea of our method is to leverage *socially similar Tweets* for pre-training.
evidence.claim_quote: We perform a variety of downstream tasks using TwHIN-BERT on Tweet data. Our experiments demonstrate that TwHIN-BERT outperforms previously released language models on both semantic and social engagement prediction tasks.
